items.question: What bodily destruction follows the horn-tearing and earth-striking of the enemy?
premises: the body is struck against earth
items.inference: the enemy is destroyed by horn-tearing and forceful earth-striking
uncertainties: the exact subject and object are not named in this verse
items.plain_english: Tearing the belly with horns, striking on earth with speed.
